question: What methods have been explored to couple light from a fiber onto a chip under cryogenic temperature?

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: Answer identifies grating couplers paired with angle-polished fibers as one demonstrated method family for fiber-to-chip light coupling at cryogenic temperatures.
examples: diffraction grating-based coupling using polished fiber facets

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: Answer identifies adiabatic coupling, in which the optical mode gradually transfers from a slowly tapered fiber to a tapered on-chip waveguide, as the second demonstrated cryogenic coupling method.
examples: mode gradually transfers from a slowly tapered fiber to a tapered waveguide
adiabatic evanescent coupling using tapered fiber and waveguide

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: Answer cites quantified results from the demonstrations: millikelvin operation (e.g., 7 mK in a dilution refrigerator), coupling efficiencies (~25% single-pass for grating coupling, >50% for adiabatic couplers), and yield (e.g., 75% of glued couplers surviving the first cooldown).
examples: over 50% efficiency in the telecom band at mK temperatures
18 of 24 glued couplers survived the first cooldown

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: Answer explains that a gluing procedure fixes the fiber to the chip, providing mechanical rigidity such that packaged couplers remain stable and maintain performance over many cooling cycles between room and cryogenic temperature.
examples: fibers glued to the chip so alignment survives thermal cycling
efficiency unchanged from room temperature to mK over repeated cooldowns

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: Answer discusses the trade-off that adiabatic couplers are inherently sensitive to alignment (making them less suited to cryogenics than grating couplers), and that special rigid packaging was developed to overcome this.
examples: adiabatic couplers are alignment-sensitive, so rigid packaging was developed
grating couplers with angle-polished fibers ease alignment

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: Answer notes that fixed glued couplers are scalable, providing access to many optical input/output ports without needing in-situ piezoelectric stages, control wires, or manual realignment in the cryostat, enabling multi-device monitoring on a single chip.
examples: access to many I/O ports without a corresponding number of stages and control wires
experiments impractical with in-situ piezoelectric stages become feasible
individually monitor many devices on a single chip

ingredients.name: valuable_2
ingredients.criterion: Answer discusses the bandwidth of the methods, noting that adiabatic coupling offers compact, broadband transmission approaching near-unity levels across various telecom wavelengths.
examples: broadband light transmission approaching near-unity for various wavelengths
compact and broadband coupler in the telecom band

ingredients.name: valuable_3
ingredients.criterion: Answer notes applicability to different device types and applications, e.g., reflection-type devices demonstrated with compatibility to transmission devices using grating-coupler pairs, and relevance to integrated quantum optical, optomechanical, and electro-optic devices.
examples: reflection-type device demonstrated; compatible with transmission devices using grating coupler pairs
paves the way for integrated quantum optical, optomechanical, and electro-optic devices
